preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 3 and all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[:3])
preconditions.description: Input consists of at least 3 non-empty lines: first line is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 100), second line contains two integers n and k (2 ≤ n ≤ 1000, k = 2), and the following lines describe two drawings (each drawing starts with an integer m followed by m edges, each edge is a pair of integers u and v where 1 ≤ u, v ≤ n)

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:] if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: All non-empty lines after the first two lines represent edges as pairs of integers (u, v) where u and v are valid node identifiers (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n)

postconditions.description: First line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating whether a valid Tree of Life can be reconstructed from the two given drawings

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(line.strip() != '' and len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If output is 'YES', the following n lines describe a valid Tree of Life with n nodes (1 to n) and n-1 edges, where each line is a pair (u, v) representing an edge in the tree

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n and u != v for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for u, v in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: All edges in the output tree are valid (u ≠ v and 1 ≤ u, v ≤ n)

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(edge in (stdin.splitlines()[i] for i in range(3, 3 + m1)) or edge in (stdin.splitlines()[i] for i in range(3 + m1 + 1, 3 + m1 + 1 + m2)) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for edge in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: Every edge in the output tree must be present in at least one of the two input drawings (m1 and m2 are the number of edges in the first and second drawings, respectively)

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(set(' '.join(line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])) == n - 1
postconditions.description: The output tree has exactly n-1 edges (no cycles, connected)
